main_source_hash_format: Sorted src/main relative path UTF-8 + NUL + content for every regular file.
scope: Eight AE2S native GUI lessons in both languages: W hold, search focus, live semantic targets, matching encoding modes, native containers preserved after independent demos.
Actual drive and cell-workbench item insertion synchronizes and advances the guide; disabled ghost slots stay unresolved until available.
Machine clips share the live/demo resource; forward/backward scene seeking reconstructs deterministic GUI frames in Java and Markdown scenes.
Guide placement includes actual AE2S toolbar/side-panel exclusions; resizing uses native slot coordinates.
24 animations, 25 guide pages, P2P and powered-machine regressions, optional Ponder client/world and dedicated-server startup.
limitations: Linux x64 llvmpipe; arbitrary GPUs, modpacks, and other AE2 implementations are not certified.

Demonstration inventories are declarative. Native drive/workbench insertion is performed in acceptance; Inscriber progress and fast-result conditions are additionally checked with synchronized-state fixtures, not a full automated production network.
External Revo UI/FTB Quests/Media/CraftTweaker are not installed for this AE2S-specific acceptance.
Main CI build; no tag or formal GitHub Release created by this change.
